content:
{'text': '華盛頓——在針對總統的訴訟推進之際，一名聯邦法官於週二裁定，必須允許CNN、Politico及MS NOW在特朗普上個月對這些傳媒機構實施禁令後，恢復在白宮的採訪工作。', 'paragraph_context': '華盛頓——在針對總統的訴訟推進之際，一名聯邦法官於週二裁定，必須允許CNN、Politico及MS NOW在特朗普上個月對這些傳媒機構實施禁令後，恢復在白宮的採訪工作。'}

{'text': '「本院將批准（初步禁制令的動議）……裁定原告不僅在正當程序（due process）的爭議上很可能勝訴，亦會在其兩項第一修正案（First Amendment）的爭議上勝訴，」由特朗普委任的美國聯邦地方法院法官Timothy Kelly在其命令中寫道。', 'paragraph_context': '「The Court will grant [a motion for a preliminary injunction]...finding that Plaintiffs are likely to succeed not only on their due process claim, but also on their two First Amendment claims,」U.S. District Judge Timothy Kelly, a Trump appointee, wrote in his order.'}

{'text': '這些傳媒機構聲稱，特朗普因為其新聞報導而對它們作出報復，並基於其立場觀點對它們作出非法歧視。此外，它們亦指出，特朗普在實施禁令前並未給予它們足夠的正當程序。', 'paragraph_context': 'The news outlets claimed that Trump had retaliated against them for their coverage and had unlawfully discriminated against them because of their viewpoints. Additionally, they argued that Trump didn’t provide them with sufficient due process prior to implementing the ban.'}

{'text': 'Kelly在其命令中，對政府一方聲稱禁令是為了保障國家安全所需的說法表示質疑。', 'paragraph_context': 'In his order, Kelly expressed skepticism about the administration’s argument that the ban was necessary to protect national security.'}

{'text': '「首先，並無任何證據顯示特朗普總統在決定撤銷原告採訪通行證之時，是依據9月22日信件中所提及、聲稱『威脅國家安全及／或散播虛假資訊』的所謂『報導事件』，亦無任何直接證據顯示國家安全當時曾在其考慮之列，」Kelly寫道。', 'paragraph_context': '「To begin, there is no evidence that President Trump relied on any of the ‘reporting incidents’ that purportedly ‘threatened national security/and or spread falsehoods’ referenced in the September 22 letters when he decided to revoke Plaintiffs’ hard passes, or any direct evidence that national security was even on his mind then,」Kelly wrote.'}

{'text': 'Kelly在上個月已就特朗普9月18日的採訪禁令頒下臨時禁制令，當時裁定該禁令很可能違憲。', 'paragraph_context': 'Kelly put a temporary restraining order on Trump’s Sept. 18 press ban last month after finding that it was likely unconstitutional.'}

{'text': '特朗普於9月突然頒布禁令，並指控這些傳媒機構就其政府發布「假新聞」。特朗普聲稱，傳媒在報導他時不應發布「虛構與謊言」（FICTION AND LIES）。特朗普首次在橢圓形辦公室宣布禁令時，並無援引任何特定報道，或指明某家傳媒機構或記者的問題。他反而表示，是「過去數年累積下來的報道」促使他作出這項決定。', 'paragraph_context': 'Trump abruptly issued the ban in September and accused the outlets of publishing “fake news” about his administration. Trump argued that outlets shouldn’t be able to report “FICTION AND LIES” when covering him. When first announcing the ban from the Oval Office, Trump did not cite any particular report or issue with a specific outlet or reporter. Rather, he said it was “really just cumulative stories over the last few years” that prompted the decision.'}

{'text': '然而，在庭上，特朗普政府的律師辯稱，總統禁止這些傳媒機構採訪白宮，是基於「國家安全」的考量。據HuffPost報導，司法部聲稱有關總統在白宮範圍內興建宴會廳、以及伊朗戰爭與彈藥庫存量不足的報道均威脅到國家安全。', 'paragraph_context': 'In court, however, lawyers for the Trump administration argued that the president barred the outlets from covering the White House because of “national security” concerns. As HuffPost reported, the Justice Department claimed that reports about the president’s ballroom on the grounds of the White House and the Iran war and depleted ammunition levels threatened national security.'}

{'text': 'Kelly在9月24日頒下臨時禁制令時表示，他發現案卷中「並無任何內容」可以支持該說法。', 'paragraph_context': 'When issuing the temporary restraining order on Sept. 24, Kelly said he found “nothing in the record” to support that claim.'}

{'text': '相反，法官指出，特朗普在禁止這些傳媒機構時，「聚焦於報道所謂缺乏真確性及負面之處」。', 'paragraph_context': 'Instead, the judge noted that when Trump banned the outlets, he “focused on the alleged lack of truthfulness and negativity” of the reporting.'}

{'text': '受影響記者的採訪證可讓他們進出白宮範圍並履行新聞採訪輪換職責，這些證件在Kelly的初步命令頒下後不足一天便已發還。然而，自此之後，白宮仍持續限制採訪。', 'paragraph_context': 'The affected journalists’ press badges, which grant them access to the White House complex and allow them to fulfill press pool duties, were returned less than a day after Kelly’s initial order. However, since then, the White House has continued to restrict access.'}

{'text': 'CNN於10月5日報導，政府阻止了Politico的記者登上空軍一號，而該網絡一小批隨總統出行的外地採訪團記者亦被拒諸門外。', 'paragraph_context': 'On Oct. 5, CNN reported that the administration stopped Politico reporters from boarding Air Force One and that a small group of the network’s reporters who travel with the president as part of an out-of-town travel press pool were also denied access.'}

{'text': '代表這些傳媒機構的律師指出，禁令違反第一修正案，並向法官表示，政府投訴的時機已暴露了特朗普的真正意圖：那些貶損記者專業操守或缺乏禮節的信件及通知，都是在傳媒提出訴訟後才發出的。', 'paragraph_context': 'Lawyers for the outlets argue the ban is a violation of the First Amendment and told the judge that the timing of the administration’s complaints gave away Trump’s real intent: Letters and notices denigrating journalists’ professionalism or lack of decorum arrived only after the outlets sued.'}

{'text': '特朗普政府的律師則堅持，進入白宮是「一項特權而非權利」，總統應有權「即使是基於歧視性立場觀點的理由」拒絕讓傳媒進入。', 'paragraph_context': 'Lawyers for the Trump administration insist that access to the White House is a “privilege not a right” and that the president should be allowed to deny access “even for viewpoint discriminatory reasons.”'}

{'text': '在10月8日就傳媒機構的初步禁制令申請舉行聆訊前，美國檢察官Brett Shumate提交了一份篇幅冗長的動議，為特朗普的決定作出辯護，聲稱過去的總統曾「挑選」他們想採訪的記者，或給予其他記者「特別通行權」。此外，政府一方聲稱白宮範圍「根本不是一個『公共討論場地』（forum）」，因此白宮「沒有責任邀請記者提問」。', 'paragraph_context': 'Ahead of a hearing on the preliminary injunction request by the news outlets on Oct. 8, U.S. attorney Brett Shumate filed a lengthy motion defending Trump’s decision by suggesting that presidents in the past “picked and chose” reporters they wanted to cover them or granted others “special access.” Further, the government claims the White House complex is “not a ‘forum’ at all” and therefore the White House “has no obligation to call on reporters.”'}
